Place: Art Must Be Artificial: Perspectives of AI in the Visual Arts exhibition
Description: The first exhibition at Diriyah Art Futures, "Art Must Be Artificial: Perspectives of AI in the Visual Arts", presents a sweeping history of the evolution of computational art, showcasing iconic algorithmic art spanning from the 1960s to the present day. The exhibition presents a survey of leading historic and current international artists using computational technology, including major Saudi artists. These pioneers are charting the evolution of the homo digitalis, the new human civilization we are experiencing. By posing questions around nature, technology and the creative process, their works help us to better understand the complexities and issues of our increasingly digital world. Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times. Children under 8 are not allowed in the exhibition. The exhibition is accompanied by a series of public programmes, including masterclasses, practical workshops, talks and performances.
